next_steps.action: Measure the boost output diode cathode voltage (Vout) and the FB pin. Also check the output diode anode vs cathode to confirm it is conducting.

measure.what: Boost output voltage + FB pin + diode forward voltage
measure.where: Output diode cathode (Vout) and anode; FB pin per datasheet
measure.expected: Vout = designed boost voltage. FB at VREF per datasheet.
measure.safety: Boost outputs can be high voltage; verify probe rating.

interpretations.then: Boost is regulating. Issue is downstream of the boost.

interpretations.if_result: Switching present but Vout = Vin (no boost)
interpretations.then: Output diode is open OR the switch FET is not actually switching (gate-drive fault). Check diode forward conduction and switch-pin waveform.

interpretations.if_result: Vout low and FB pulled high
interpretations.then: Boost is trying but cannot reach regulation. Could be overloaded output, weak inductor, or weak switch. Check output load.

next_steps.requires_info_note: Need boost datasheet for FB pin and VREF.
